Alolalia is a [[holiday]] celebrated on August 29 or [[Leo 14]]. It celebrates the [[2021 revelation]].

== First Alolalia ==
[[Immanuelle]] made a video for the first Alolalia celebration in [[2022]]. [[Alolalia (video)]]
